release_notes: Ban 0.0.31: sua goc loi chong trung hoa don — khoa duy nhat nay gom ca nguoi mua, nen hai ho so cong ty cung mua cua mot nguoi ban voi cung ky hieu/so hoa don khong con ghi de len nhau. Database tu nang cap khi mo app (co sao luu .bak-schema2 kem ca -wal/-shm truoc khi doi cau truc; hong giua chung thi rollback). Sua them 4 loi trong chinh buoc nang cap (PRAGMA foreign_keys bi bo qua trong transaction, thieu rollback, sao luu sau khi da ghi, tra id theo thieu cot), va sua khoa gop trung khi dong bo: nhan ten truong thay the cua API, dem 0 so hoa don, tinh ca nguoi mua — truoc day co the gop nham nhieu hoa don thanh mot.
